ValidationRule.description: Desde el estado Draft no se puede cerrar una oportunidad
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( AND( opportunity_expiration_ind_type__c = true, NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Lost')) ), opportunity_expiration_ind_type__c = false ), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName='Draft_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Confidential_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName='Privileged_Opportunity' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Ready to close'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Approval') ), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),'Draft Opp') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: In order to close the opportunity, please advance to the stage 'Proposal'.
